{"brief":"The user particularly likes thrillers, with Zodiac among their favorite films. They find serial killers interesting and appreciate the film’s depth, immersive period setting, and detailed look at detectives, police, and investigators. They felt its nearly three-hour length helped immerse them in that world. They tentatively identify with Robert Graysmith because he is awkward and bumbly. They described the lake murder as the most memorable scene because it is vivid and horrific—not explicitly as their favorite scene. They could not recall similar movies seen recently.

They generally do not like comic-book movies much. They have heard of Once Upon a Deadpool but have not seen it and are not particularly interested. However, they said they really wanted to see Deadpool and would probably be more willing to watch it than most comic-book films: its concept seems different from standard superhero fare, and its comedic emphasis appeals to them. They also explicitly confirmed enjoying comedy when asked.

They are not big fans of action movies such as Die Hard or Rambo: they do not hate them, but find them boring and tire of watching many. They know of Mission Impossible but have never seen it.

They say they are not picky about actors, prefer some over others, and have no single favorite. Their follow-up wording about whether disliking an actor would prevent watching a film is ambiguous, so that specific criterion remains unclear. Tom Hanks was introduced by the interviewer, not independently named as a favorite actor. Asked for their favorite Hanks movie, they chose Catch Me If You Can, praising its interesting, true-story basis and Leonardo DiCaprio, whom they consider a good actor. They confirmed finding the film exciting. It has been a long time since they watched it, so they could not recall a specific memorable scene."}
